reviews.author: Pau Vigil
reviews.text: A must try “tapas” experience. Have no doubt, Esteve and his team deliver. Will definitely comeback, thank you 5/5

reviews.author: David Weatherill
reviews.text: Such friendly staff, translated the whole menu just for us. Amazing food, really authentic. Coming again!

reviews.author: Angela Bestauti
reviews.text: Everything we had — calamares a la romana, cazuela del día, croquetas, bravas — was delicious and had its own twist. The croquetas are their specialty and it shows: solid, meaty, not flour balls. The owner himself, whose name is Esteve, is a gentle soul and a friendly host. The vermouth is very aromatic.

reviews.author: Alana A
reviews.text: Excellent food and service. The owner is very attentive and friendly. Local, authentic place — a must visit.

reviews.author: Simon
reviews.text: Because it was so delicious, we came back the next day. Today we chose paella. It tasted just as good. Whenever we are back on holiday, this restaurant will be our first choice.
